bindings.exchange: IHE ITI TF Rev 20.2 (XDS.b, XCA, XCPD); XDS Metadata Update Rev 1.14 (ITI-57); MHD 4.2.4; sIPS 1.0.0

statement: Self-assessment of a demonstrator against the IPS Preservation Envelope Profile 0.4.0, using synthetic data only. It is not a claim of conformance with any other specification, and the Checker is from the same project, so the result is not independent assurance.

PRES-04.party: The operator of each demonstrator instance

declarationsNotProvided.SEC-01: No authorisation model: the demonstrator has no users and is not for use with real data.
declarationsNotProvided.SEC-02: Cross-border identification, authentication, consent, audit and lawful basis are out of scope of a demonstrator on synthetic data.
declarationsNotProvided.SEC-03: No clinical risk management: the demonstrator is not for clinical use.
declarationsNotProvided.PRES-05: Option PP is not claimed; the event chain head is held locally.

PROV-02.c.method: Code review: an attested issuance is produced only by the explicit attestation action (DemoService.attest); composition, validation, packaging and registration never add Composition.attester or legalAuthenticator.

evidenceManifest.note: The CI evidence manifest (build/evidence/manifest.json) binds the reports to a commit.
